name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: 0.13.5 CHILFOS FIX05 over Lizalfos FIX05 0.12.5 (the Lizalfos only gains its Jump Attack defense). The Chilfos (E_KK) fights with four learnable combos (one ends with a backstep, a real spear throw and a fast restore). When its posture break runs out it plays its stagger once and straightens up without staggering again. Repeated Jump Attacks meet a real guard and real parries (the native mid-air or landing rebound), one result per jump. Both thrusts of its fast doubles can be parried. The Helm Splitter jumps to its upright head, and Link's torso no longer dips after a Mortal Draw kill. One clash, one spark and one result per spear attack; its spear never breaks when it blocks or parries; it parries and counters. HP and posture are two independent ways to win: HP 0 kills it normally, hidden skills deal ordinary damage, and at 100 posture it staggers for 3 s: a new sword hit, Shield Attack then Helm Splitter, or B for Link's native Mortal Draw finishes it.
